title: The first-entry smoke check stops waiting on frames it does not need
items: The automated check of the door, the navigation guide and the evidence menu no longer times out on a slow machine. The town now draws at about 8-10 seconds a frame on the build machines, and each of those clicks used to wait on about ten frames.
It still checks that the guide dismisses and remembers the choice, and that the evidence menu takes a real mouse click. It also logs how long each click took.
